newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Sydney Futures Exchange says new SPI record set.
newsitem.headline: Sydney Futures Exchange says new SPI record set.

text.p: The Share Price Index (SPI) futures contract based on the Australian Stock Exchange's All Ordinaries index set a new trading record on Wednesday, the Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) said.
A record 37,355 SPI futures contracts were traded, representing a nominal value of A$2.2 billion, the SFE said.
The previous record of 27,801 contracts was set on March 19.
